newsitem.title: USA: NuTek sets acquisition of oil service Co.
newsitem.headline: NuTek sets acquisition of oil service Co.

text.p: NuTek Inc on Thursday said it has signed a contract to acquire Non-Magnetic Rental Tools Inc, a Louisiana-based oil field service company specializing in the rental of downhole drilling equipment.
Financial details were undisclosed, but NuTek said the deal should add, on a fully diluted basis, about $0.15 in earnings per share for 1997.
Non Magnetic's revenues for 1996 were about $3.6 million, an increase of 40% over 1995. Revenues for 1997 are expected to be $5.4 million, NuTek said in a statement.
